# CodeBlock
Atlas Code Block v1 — a labelled, monospace panel that shows a short code snippet with a copy button. 2 variants × 3 sizes (6 total); "Show header" toggles the filename row, "Show line numbers" toggles the gutter.

When to use: readable snippets, install commands and examples in docs and onboarding. When not to use: as a code editor, for long files, or for text the user must edit.

Variant=default shows the full code at once. Variant=typing writes the code out character by character with a blinking cursor, and is drawn here mid-write; reduced motion shows the full code immediately. Plain monospace text with no syntax colours. The copy button confirms with a check and announces "Copied" to assistive tech. Give the block an accessible name through the filename or language label.
